T0546.title: OAuth Grant
T0546.definition: An authorization grant that lets an application access resources on behalf of a user or tenant.
T0546.description: OAuth grants let applications access resources on behalf of users, but scope, redirect URI, refresh-token, and consent misconfiguration can create long-lived data-access risk. Controls focus on minimal scopes, application review, token rotation, abnormal grant revocation, and administrator approval for high-risk permissions.
T0546.usageExample: Assess OAuth Grant related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
